text: My main symptom is Fever and altered mentation. I also have Profuse sweating, Generalized rigidity, Confusion and disorientation, Ability to move all limbs, Normal deep tendon reflexes with bilateral downgoing plantar responses.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Neuroleptic Malignant Syndrome (NMS).

The combination of fever, altered mentation (confusion/disorientation), profuse sweating, and generalized rigidity in a patient taking haloperidol is highly suggestive of NMS. The normal deep tendon reflexes and plantar responses help distinguish this from other causes of rigidity like serotonin syndrome or meningitis.
